correctness.rationale: With nonempty neighboring-disjoint subsets, a cell cannot be invariant under any nontrivial 7-cycle rotation: all seven coordinates would have to agree. A fixed point would force just such an invariant open cell. The actual ordinary quotient therefore has one cell per free orbit; rotations induce the Koszul sign on the oriented product factors. I independently generated orbit representatives using a different canonical order, checked the full chain squares, and reduced the integral boundary by degree-descending sparse unimodular unit-pivot cancellation. The cell counts are (312,1452,2640,2340,1008,168); the different pivot order gives 3958 cancellations, leaving ranks (1,1,1,1,0,0) and the sole nonzero boundary [−14] in degree 2. This gives the claimed integral groups. The cover one-skeleton is connected by single-coordinate changes through all 2184 proper colorings. In the quotient, a spanning tree leaves 1141 generators, with actual triangle and square words having the correct exponent sums on all 2640 two-cells. A different tree and Tietze order gave 1140 single-occurrence eliminations and one generator, with 42 nonzero relators of length 14. With a single generator, a cyclically reduced length-14 relator is g^14 or g^(−14). The difference from 46 in the frozen transcript reflects the choice of reduction, not a difference in presented groups. The connected regular seven-fold cover gives kernel the unique index-seven subgroup C₂ of C₁₄. Replay: python /workspace/checks/hom.py (helper words.py; transcript /workspace/checks/hom.txt). No CW chain calculation was taken to determine higher homotopy or a manifold model.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: With the cited integral cohomology of X, the C7 action on it is trivial (odd-order action on the free rank-one top group, and trivial automorphism group of C2). Localizing away from 7, transfer gives the quotient cohomology as the invariants. At 7 the cohomological Cartan–Leray sequence has only the q=0 and q=3 rows, each over H*(C7;Z_(7)). The degree-3 generator must transgress onto the generator in degree 4: otherwise by the module property all d4 maps vanish, contradicting the finite dimension of the quotient and nonzero classes in arbitrarily high even degrees. Hence the two rows cancel in high degrees, leaving only H⁰ and H³ free of rank one and H² of order seven at 7. Recombining with the away-from-7 result and using universal coefficients gives exactly the homology table. This implication does not prove the fundamental group of either space; that is the distinct computed claim.

value.rationale: The passage from the pentagon benchmark to seven source vertices gives a natural next orbit-space case. Knowing that the actual group is cyclic, not just that the abelianization has order fourteen, determines the fundamental-group extension and the fundamental group of its natural covering space. This topology is not read off from cohomology and is useful in comparing combinatorial cycle-colouring spaces and their symmetry quotients. The homology replay is supporting context; the value does not rest on recomputing that already implied table or claiming a lens-space homotopy type.
